top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Drop as 10-Year Treasury Yield Passes 5%
top_signals.summary: US stock futures declined in early trading after the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield touched the highest level since 2007 ahead of a Federal Reserve interest-rate decision on Wednesday, when traders expect an increase.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: México pierde a turistas que más gastan y apuesta por China
top_signals.summary: Read story in EnglishMéxico busca la manera de reactivar el crecimiento en sus destinos de playa, que alguna vez estuvieron en auge y donde las visitas de turistas de alto poder adquisitivo se ha desacelerado, otra señal preocupante para una economía que atraviesa dificultades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Merz to Respond to Surging Prices as ‘Breaking Point’ Reached
top_signals.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said his coalition will take action on “price gouging” amid mounting calls to alleviate the burden on German consumers from surging fuel prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
